blocks.html: Construction of temporary storm enclosures must comply with the requirements of this code, including the fire-resistance rating of the building to which it is appurtenant, and Chapter 11. Such enclosures may be permitted during the period between November 15 and the following April 15 and must be removed at the end of this period.
